enhanced_information: In the maintenance treatment of patients with a kidney transplant, the commonly used combination of drugs includes Tacrolimus, mycophenolate mofetil, and glucocorticoids. Tacrolimus provides immunosuppression, mycophenolate mofetil inhibits T and B lymphocyte proliferation, and glucocorticoids offer anti-inflammatory effects as adjunct therapy. This combination aligns with standard practice and consensus guidelines.
